thb.text: Phenax became the first mortal to escape the Underworld, unnoticed by Athreos or Erebos, and ascended to godhood.

He assembles Returned, conquers Odunos, slaughters its population and binds their souls to the Black Oak, while Tymaret witnesses his escape and informs Erebos, who lets him leave the Underworld as a Returned to catch Phenax.
A rarely whispered tale says Phenax was destined to free the Titans, so mortals killed him and the gods later allowed his escape.
